source_line: Sources: Kalshi odds Nov 13 2026; Fed calendar; BLS schedule
caption:
97% — that's the market's odds the Fed RAISES rates at its December 9 meeting, per Kalshi. Fed governor Waller says a half-point hike should be considered after core inflation ran 0.3% for a third straight month.

Here's the part almost nobody mentions: November's inflation report comes out December 10 — one day AFTER the decision. They'll set your card rates, loan rates and mortgage pressure before seeing the newest numbers.

My take: when the referee can't see the field, the players pay. And the players are anyone with a loan.

Should the Fed wait one day for the data? 👇
